mission: Self-improvement harness research for LLMs — autonomous evolution, harness engineering, and agent-driven optimization

sota_gap.description: Bridging the gap between published baseline (0.199) and our current Brier (0.21570) for NBA prediction
sota_gap.target_improvement: -0.0157 Brier reduction via agent-driven feature evolution and self-improving loops

major_frameworks.title: AutoHarness: Automatic Code Harness Synthesis for LLM Agents
major_frameworks.summary: Enables smaller LLMs (Gemini-2.5-Flash) to automatically synthesize code harnesses that constrain agent behavior to legal actions. Uses iterative code refinement with environment feedback to prevent invalid moves. Successfully prevented illegal moves across 145 TextArena games and enabled smaller models to outperform larger ones.
major_frameworks.application_to_nba: Can generate harness code to constrain feature selection to legal/non-correlated features, prevent overfitting features, enforce max_features constraint automatically

major_frameworks.title: SAGE: Multi-Agent Self-Evolution for LLM Reasoning
major_frameworks.authors: University of Science and Technology of China (USTC)
major_frameworks.summary: Closed-loop framework enabling LLMs to improve autonomously via co-evolution of 4 specialized agents: Challenger (generates hard tasks), Planner (structures reasoning), Solver (produces answers), Critic (filters quality). Uses only ~500 seed examples to bootstrap self-improvement. Demonstrates consistent gains across model scales.
key_techniques: Four-role agent co-evolution (Challenger, Planner, Solver, Critic)
Adversarial curriculum learning with difficulty rewards
Task-Relative REINFORCE++ with per-role advantage normalization
Critic-based quality filtering (α=0.7 threshold to prevent curriculum drift)
major_frameworks.application_to_nba: Can apply multi-agent evolution to feature generation: Proposer agent generates new features, Evaluator agent scores them, Critic filters low-quality features. Challenger generates hard edge cases. Directly analogous to GA mutation/crossover with quality gates.

major_frameworks.title: EvoAgentX: An Automated Framework for Evolving Agentic Workflows
major_frameworks.summary: Open-source Python framework enabling construction, evaluation, and refinement of LLM-based agents through automated feedback loops. Generates multi-agent workflows from natural language goals, integrates 25+ tools, supports human-in-the-loop oversight. Core innovation: self-evolution engine driven by task-specific evaluation.
key_techniques: AgentManager: instantiates and manages agent instances
Tool integration: code interpreters, search, databases, image analysis, browser automation
major_frameworks.application_to_nba: Can adapt EvoAgentX to auto-generate NBA feature engineering agents. Proposer agent suggests features, Evaluator agent scores Brier, Refiner agent modifies top-k. HITL allows human oversight of risky feature changes.

major_frameworks.title: Andrej Karpathy's AutoResearch: The Minimal Agent Loop for Autonomous ML Optimization
major_frameworks.authors: Andrej Karpathy (former OpenAI, Tesla AI Director)
major_frameworks.summary: Groundbreaking framework for autonomous ML experimentation. AI agent runs in tight loop: modify code → train 5min → measure loss → commit if better → repeat. Ran 700 experiments in 2 days, discovering 20 optimizations. CEO Tobias Lütke (Shopify) reported 19% performance gain overnight with 37 experiments. The pattern we've adopted in Karpathy cycle.
key_techniques: Fair-game architecture: model, optimizer, hyperparameters, batch size all tunable
major_frameworks.application_to_nba: EXACT MATCH to our Kaggle Karpathy loop. Modify feature_engine.py or mutation hyperparameters → 5min GA run → measure Brier → commit if <0.21570. We have scripts/kaggle/nba_karpathy_loop.py already implementing this. Can extend with Brier-aware commit thresholds, feature takeover detection.

major_frameworks.title: Experiential Reflective Learning for Self-Improving LLM Agents
major_frameworks.summary: Enables LLM agents to learn rapidly from task trajectories by reflecting on outcomes and generating reusable heuristics. Heuristics are retrieved and injected into context at test time to guide execution. Demonstrates fast environment adaptation without retraining.
major_frameworks.application_to_nba: Can apply to agent memory for feature engineering: store high-impact feature categories as heuristics, retrieve when faced with new prediction tasks. Example: 'When offense has low AST%, weight passing features 2x' — learned from trajectory analysis.

major_frameworks.title: Trajectory-Informed Memory Generation for Self-Improving Agent Systems
major_frameworks.summary: Automatically extracts actionable learnings from agent execution trajectories and uses contextual memory retrieval to improve future performance. Bridges experience collection and knowledge reuse.
major_frameworks.application_to_nba: Track GA trajectories: which feature combinations led to Brier improvements? Store as memory-indexed by context (team matchup, time of season). Reuse proven combinations in similar contexts.

major_frameworks.title: MIT CSAIL: Self-Improvement of LLM Agents through Reinforcement Learning at Scale
major_frameworks.summary: DigiRL framework for autonomous RL applied to realistic digital agent tasks (Android emulator control, web automation). EnCompass system searches over LLM decision paths, filtering for best solutions. Improved translation accuracy 15-40% over non-searching baseline.
key_techniques: Path search over LLM decision trees
major_frameworks.application_to_nba: Apply EnCompass to feature selection: search over feature subsets, evaluate all paths via Brier, keep path with best generalization. Particularly useful for preventing local optima in GA.

major_frameworks.title: Stanford CS329A: Self-Improving AI Agents (Course + Research)
major_frameworks.summary: Comprehensive curriculum covering self-improvement techniques: constitutional AI, verifiers, test-time compute scaling, tool augmentation, memory, multimodal reasoning. Covers both single-agent and multi-agent self-improvement. Research focus on continuous autonomous improvement.
major_frameworks.application_to_nba: All directly applicable: constitutional AI for feature ethics (no PII, no insider trading data), verifiers for Brier gate-keeping, test-time search over feature combinations, tool augmentation (odds scraper, injury API), memory for player history.

major_frameworks.title: Anthropic Claude 2026: Computer Use Agent & Long-Running Autonomous Operations
major_frameworks.summary: Claude Computer Use Agent enables 21.2 average tool calls per task (+116% in 6 months). Long-running operations enable 50-100+ hour autonomous sprints. 90%+ of Claude's own code is now AI-authored. High-level objective → agent team solves autonomously over days/weeks.
major_frameworks.application_to_nba: Deploy Claude Code agents to run Karpathy loop continuously for weeks. Multi-agent team: Feature Engineer → GA Runner → Evaluator → Committer. Can operate unattended, report via Telegram daily.

open_source_repos.description: Demonstrates self-improvement in code generation: 17% → 53% on SWE-Bench Verified. Can be adapted for feature engineering code generation.

research_summary.key_insight: Self-improvement harness is THE differentiator in 2026. Karpathy's autoresearch pattern, SAGE's multi-agent co-evolution, and AutoHarness's constraint synthesis can close the 0.0157 gap via autonomous feature engineering.
recommended_priority: Phase 1: Extend Karpathy loop with Brier gates + Telegram reporting (1 week, -0.001 Brier)
Phase 2: Deploy SAGE 4-agent framework on HF Spaces (2 weeks, -0.002 to -0.003 Brier)
Phase 3: Add AutoHarness + EnCompass path search (1 month, -0.002 to -0.004 Brier)
Phase 4: Deploy Claude orchestrated 24/7 multi-agent team (ongoing, -0.003 to -0.008 Brier)
research_summary.reasoning: All techniques are (a) published peer-reviewed or by major labs (Google, MIT, Stanford, Anthropic), (b) have open-source reference implementations, (c) have been empirically validated on non-trivial tasks (games, coding, reasoning), (d) directly map to our NBA feature engineering workflow
